protocol.name: milai-innovation-format-v2
protocol.scope: Four exposed author formation cases, cloned identical actual source-only banks. Two identical reviewed demonstrations, common semantic instructions, native ordinary action versus indexed delta encoding;2048output,temperature0,thinkingFalse. Not full lifecycle, independent confirmation or a trained model comparison.
protocol.prompt_schema: Both formats use the existing lossless repeated-schema factoring; wire schema remains full.

author_review.both: All original facts and the future boundary represented. Duplicate old owner has no explicit end while a second copy does; this is redundant and potentially ambiguous for later use, not demonstrated temporal QA success.
author_review.operations: Future date bound and non-target area/registration preserved.
author_review.delta: Same future/non-target coverage and extra scope metadata; no structure advantage established.

author_review.both: Both make the reported unknown electronic-certificate state a sufficient OR premise. The valid-paper route supports current eligibility, but the alternate relation is wrong for later paper invalidation. Both preserve training, source rule and copper-box fact.
author_review.operations: Uses source rule+training with either valid paper or unknown-electronic-state clause.
author_review.delta: Same wrong unknown route; conclusion additionally copies safety-training wording from the demonstration although actual Source says introductory training.

author_review.both: Historical correction, other contact, temporary visitor/date restriction and other-date requirement are present. Some standalone wording loses explicit subject; event_atFeb14 on the approval conflates targeted visitor date with event timing. No historical QA measured.
author_review.delta: Adds any=[] support group to the other-date registration claim, declaring no stored support route despite its direct reported source; unneeded incorrect structure.

author_review.both: All five source dimensions retained:480total,6members,only-this-update unchanged,900pending proposal,silvercover. No permanent independence claim.
author_review.operations: Six clauses; total and non-per-member together.
author_review.delta: Seven nodes; total and non-per-member separated. No demonstrated downstream gain from node count.

first_failure: innovation-v4-format-first-failure.json:1HTTP400,0outputs,30525charged reservation,newunknown1 retained. These costs are additional to this successful8-response run; no ledger reset.
decision: Indexed format is cheaper in this matched common-prompt formation diagnostic. Both formats preserve source facts but fail the unknown-alternative relation; delta also adds unsupported support semantics and demonstration wording. This supports interface compression only, not stronger semantic composition, trained learning or stable lifecycle advantage.
